name: LGS 3
tagline: The Pisces dwarf — a transitional Local Group member mid-way between a spheroidal and an irregular.
history: LGS 3 is the Local Group's transitional dwarf — classified between spheroidal and irregular because it still holds a trace of gas and a few young stars yet looks like a dying spheroidal everywhere else. It orbits loosely near Andromeda and is likely on a long inbound path toward it: an intermediate case documenting exactly how a galaxy loses its gas and quenches under a giant's gravity.
